name: Indian 741 / 841 military
engine: 500 cc side-valve V-twin (741) or 750 cc transverse V-twin with shaft drive (841)
intro: Indian's wartime bikes. The 741 is a military Scout; the 841 is a shaft-drive desert prototype.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
